parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25965~~).

parameters.name: ForceDetach
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove ECS instances or elastic container instances in the current scaling group from the server groups to be removed. Valid values:

- true: Removes the instances.

- false: Does not remove the instances.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ServerGroup
parameters.description: The information about the load balancing server groups.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description:
The port number used by ECS instances or elastic container instances in the load balancing server group.

> This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. This parameter cannot be configured for GWLB load balancing server groups. Settings default value is 6081.

sub_parameters.name: ServerGroupId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the load balancing server group.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the load balancing server group. Valid values:

- ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).
- NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
- GWLB: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB).
